description: This file contains the implementation of the ActivationRebalancerWorker class, responsible for managing activation rebalancing across silos in the Orleans distributed runtime. It handles scheduling, statistical analysis, entropy-based rebalance decisions, migration coordination, and persistence of rebalancer state.

classes.name: ActivationRebalancerWorker
classes.description: Sealed internal class implementing the worker responsible for rebalancing grain activations across silos using entropy measures, scheduling, and migration commands.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Initializes timers and subscribes to statistics change events when the grain activates.

methods.name: OnDeactivateAsync
methods.description: Cleans up resources and unsubscribes from statistics change events when deactivated.

methods.name: OnDehydrate
methods.description: Serializes current rebalancer state for persistence.

methods.name: OnRehydrate
methods.description: Restores rebalancer state from persisted data.

methods.name: GetReport
methods.description: Returns a rebalancing report summarizing current state and statistics.

methods.name: ResumeRebalancing
methods.description: Restarts a rebalancing session and reports current status.

methods.name: SuspendRebalancing
methods.description: Suspends rebalancing activity for a specified duration.

methods.name: ReportAllMonitors
methods.description: Reports status to all active silo monitors.

methods.name: BuildReport
methods.description: Builds a comprehensive rebalancing report with current status.

methods.name: TriggerRebalancing
methods.description: Initiates a rebalancing cycle if not currently running.

methods.name: RunRebalancingCycle
methods.description: Performs a single rebalancing cycle, including entropy calculations and migration handling.

methods.name: UpdateStatistics
methods.description: Updates the internal statistics for a given silo after migration.

methods.name: ComputeEntropy
methods.description: Calculates the entropy measure based on silo activation counts and memory usages.

methods.name: ComputeHarmonicMean
methods.description: Calculates the harmonic mean of activation counts across silos.

methods.name: ComputeAllowedEntropyDeviation
methods.description: Determines the allowed entropy deviation threshold, scaling with total activations.

methods.name: ComputeAdaptiveScaling
methods.description: Calculates a scaling factor based on the number of silos and rebalancing cycle count.

methods.name: FormSiloPairs
methods.description: Creates pairs of silos with the most imbalanced activation counts for migration consideration.

methods.name: StartSession
methods.description: Begins a new rebalancing session by scheduling timers.

methods.name: StopSession
methods.description: Stops the current rebalancing session and handles state updates based on reason.

methods.name: SuspendFor
methods.description: Sets a suspension period during which rebalancing is paused.
